project.name: Living Loom — Emmanuel Kingsford Owusu Portfolio
project.objective: Present Emmanuel's graphic design, websites, web applications, and research-led systems through an original, usable, high-craft public portfolio.
project.audience: Founders, product and design leaders, institutional partners, prospective clients, collaborators, and recruiters on mobile and desktop.
project.governing_idea: Every project is a thread; one responsive ultramarine strand reveals how evidence, imagination, and engineering are woven into useful systems.
project.production_host: Vercel; production URL pending verified deployment

creative_system.visual_thesis: A warm editorial field is cut and connected by one electric-blue woven gesture; tactile physical models make systems thinking visible.
anti_goals: motion that blocks or hijacks reading

palette.contrast: warm editorial light field or graphite inverse field with a precise ultramarine route

creative_system.composition: Editorial asymmetry anchored by a stable content rail, deliberate negative space, alternating density, and 3:2 project media.
creative_system.camera: No simulated interface camera. Generated covers use grounded editorial perspective and legible physical scale.
creative_system.lighting: Directional studio light with tactile paper and material shadows; no unexplained glow.
creative_system.typography: Newsreader Variable for editorial display; Manrope Variable for body, labels, and interface; all copy remains editable HTML.
creative_system.motion: Short interruptible thread-draw, paper-reveal, crossfade, and settle behaviors; reduced-motion removes path drawing and large translation.
creative_system.sound: No audio in the public web release.
creative_system.interface: Semantic navigation, responsive reflow, keyboard access, three-state theme control, command palette, native scrolling, and reduced-motion parity.
invariants: Warm bone, graphite, and electric ultramarine retain their semantic roles.
The woven strand connects sections but never obscures controls or body copy.
Project names and descriptions remain HTML, never generated into imagery.
Generated covers remain conceptual editorial art, not literal screenshots or documentary evidence.
Primary actions work with keyboard, pointer, and touch.
No claim of legal clearance, accessibility conformance, or deployed status without evidence.
permitted_variations: Recompose section density for compact, medium, and wide viewports.
Resolve the bone or ink theme from explicit user choice or system preference.
Replace non-essential spatial motion with immediate opacity or color feedback.
Adapt the blue strand path to each route while preserving its role.

Organize by outcome and system relationship rather than disconnected discipline cards.
Keep generated covers text-free, record provenance, and use factual HTML labels and project status.
Inspect every outbound destination and remove or label anything not verified before release.
Do not claim copyright, trademark, font-license, or legal clearance; route final clearance to qualified human review.
